name: secret-guard
summary: Opt-in secrets/protected-path backstop (ships in no profile). Blocks reads of credential files, writes/edits to secret files, protected engagement/repo paths, or secret content (key material, tokens), and bash commands that leak or exfiltrate them (cat/cp/mv/base64/curl). Protected-path list kept in parity with pentest-governance-domain via verify.ts.
